indicators.short_name: EM Local Bond Index vs Canada Federal Bond Index
indicators.purpose: Compares a LEMB-derived EM local government bond index (local rates & carry, with FX stripped out) against a duration-matched synthetic Canadian federal government bond index. A rising ratio indicates EM local sovereign bonds are outperforming comparable-duration Canadian federal bonds.
indicators.smart_comment: The ratio is historically elevated at the 97.7th percentile of its 3-year range (z-score +1.97). 63-day trend momentum is positive at +2.9% annualized (slope t-stat +3.98). Momentum is decelerating: -5.9 percentage points versus 21 trading days ago (3Y acceleration z-score -1.08). A rising ratio indicates the EM local rates & carry proxy is outperforming the duration-matched Canadian federal benchmark.

overview.overall: The dashboard points to selectively elevated risk appetite rather than a uniformly strong risk-seeking regime. Portfolio factor leadership is simultaneously divergent, suggesting that the underlying equity style environment is mixed. Trend momentum is negative across most risk indicators.
overview.factors: Portfolio factor positioning is divergent rather than showing a single dominant style regime. The strongest relative positioning signal is EM ex China vs China (z-score +2.19, 96.7th percentile), while Growth vs Value is the weakest (z-score -1.72, 0.7th percentile). Positive trend momentum is visible in Quality vs US Market, Resources vs World, Profitable vs Broad Small Caps, EM ex China vs China, Growth vs Value.
overview.risk: Risk appetite is selectively elevated rather than uniformly strong across all monitored markets. Elevated positioning is currently visible in European Banks, High Yield vs Investment Grade. Momentum is decelerating in Small-Cap Speculation, US Regional Banks, European Banks, High Yield vs Investment Grade.
